name: Last Call Delivery
summary:
Last Call Delivery is an immersive VR delivery experience that puts you behind the wheel of a vehicle, racing down the highway and navigating a handful of city streets to make your deliveries. Feel the thrill of driving in first person as you dodge obstacles, speed through traffic, and shoot pizzas at houses to earn money.
